messages:
ashley: quick async check-in — finished the embedding guide updates and pushed a small fix to the portable sample app CI that was failing on mac runners. updated the quickstart to match the new env var names. opened PR #4023.

mike: nice! i skimmed the PR, left one nit on the env var docs. also saw the docker image tag got bumped — are we still pinning to the slim image?

ashley: yep pinning to node:18-slim for now, left a note in the PR why (m1 compat + image size).

sara: re: quickstart, can you add a one-liner for local dev using the mock server? devs keep asking how to run without reqs to the hosted API.

ashley: good call — will add a section: `LOCAL_DEV=true yarn start:mock` and a tiny note about token stubbing. also adding a snippet for env.example.

lee: small heads-up — sampleapp dockerfile moved from /docker/Dockerfile to /deploy/Dockerfile in the repo restructure. CI job needed the path updated, which i did in the PR. :thumbsup:

mike: thanks lee. i hit the sampleapp locally and got a weird 500 on the /embed route once — logs showed "kv cache miss" and then a retry succeeded. probably transient, but flagging in case you saw anything similar in canary.

ashley: saw one transient on canary last night too, looks like a race on cache warmup during cold-starts. filed an issue for runtime team to look at: https://redwood.company/issue/987 (will link in the PR).

devex-bot: deploybot: canary build succeeded for commit ashley/quickstart-fix (sha: a1b2c3). live on canary.

sara: awesome — once PR merges can we do a docs-only deploy? want to catch the quickstart screenshot updates in prod docs.

lee: i'll queue a docs deploy after merge. ETA ~15m.

mike: blockers?

ashley: none from my side. planned today: add mock server note, update env.example, address mike's nit, squash commits, and merge after CI green.

sara: i'll follow up on sampleapp e2e flakiness later today and leave a short checklist in the repo.

lee: if anyone needs me for the deploy I'll be on standby.

mike: cool. small reminder to label the PR with `docs` + `sampleapp` so automation picks it up.

ashley: done, labeled. thanks all :tada:
summary: devex async standup: embedding guide updates, sampleapp CI path fix, quickstart changes, canary pass, follow-ups for mock server and runtime cache race
